paragraphs: Aesys builds passenger information displays for intercity, regional and metropolitan rail. It also makes variable message signs carrying traffic and safety information on highways, in tunnels and in cities. At airports its flight information displays run from the runway to the baggage area. A further line covers industrial displays made to hold up in harsh environments.

Displays carrying road information are built to comply with a European standard for variable message signs. Design and production are handled internally at the Bergamo headquarters. Testing starts early, from the first stages of prototyping. Software staff have written interfaces for standard protocols such as NTCIP, DisplayML, Modbus and TLS.

The company says it has been growing since 1977. It reports over 400 employees dedicated to product excellence. Sales offices sit in Germany, Spain and the United States. Certifications listed include a quality management system under ISO 9001.

quote.text: Aesys has a wide range of displays and solutions to provide flexibility to be where your users are.
